deviations.why: It calls calculators a poor use of a run. This tool works through a whole opening schedule (zone per opening, log-area coefficients, GCpi sign, 16 psf floor, ASD conversion, Kzt), where chat answers usually give one worst-case DP or skip the 0.6 factor. It also fills the wind side beside roof-snow-load-calculator under the construction direction.
deviations.result: merged with tests against hand calcs

notes: Explore idea: window-design-pressure-calculator, ASCE 7-16 Ch. 26/30 Part 1 wall C&C pressures and the DP rating for every opening in a pasted schedule (Kh, Kzt ridge/escarpment/hill, Ke, zone 4/5 by corner distance, log-area GCp, low-slope cut, GCpi, 16 psf floor, debris region, CSV).
